strings.제국의 병사들에게서 이걸 입수하셨단 말입니까…?: You obtained this from the imperial soldiers...?
Magical archaeology is not my specialty... but this style appears to date from the [Second Age].
strings.2시대는…. 고대신과 마계의 권속들이 본격적인 충돌을 일으키기 전… 평화: The Second Age... Before the ancient gods and the servants of the demon realm began their great conflict. They say it was a peaceful yet strangely faded era, an uneasy time when darkness slowly gnawed at people's weaknesses and led them into corruption.
strings.…가져오신 유물 자체는 별 다른 물건이 아니지만, 무언가 아주 강력한 마: ...The relic itself is nothing remarkable. But it bears traces of having been buried with a being of extraordinary magical power.
strings.제국군이 가져간 것이 그것이겠지요. 그들이 가져간 물건의 정체는 대체 무: That must be what the imperial army took. What exactly have they carried away?
...I have a bad feeling about this.
You there, inform the residents of the contents of this proclamation.
strings.아아… 엘 아노르 산악지대 방면에서 사고가 있어서, 당분간 그 근처를 지: Ah... There has been an incident near the El Anor mountains. We're warning residents to be careful if they pass through the area for the time being.
strings.흐음, 자네라면 특별히 문제가 될 것 같지 않지만…. 만약 갈 일이 생긴: Hmm. I doubt it would pose much trouble for you... Still, be cautious if you have reason to go there.
strings.허공해를 통해서 엘 아노르 평원을 둘러싼 산악지대의 외곽으로 갈 수 있네: You can reach the outer edge of the mountains surrounding El Anor Plains through the Void Sea.
strings.우리 연합의 병사들이 경계를 하고 있으니,그들의 안내를 받아 너무 깊이: Our union's soldiers are keeping watch. Follow their directions, and take care not to venture too far in.
strings.이 앞은 엘 아노르 산악지대로 가는 길입니다.지금은 제국군의 비공정이 추: This road leads to the El Anor mountains. An imperial airship has crashed there, and the area is currently in considerable turmoil.
strings.지나가는걸 막지는 않겠지만, 매우 위험합니다. 그래도 돌아가시기 바랍니다: I won't prevent you from passing, but it is extremely dangerous. I would still advise you to turn back.
strings.(일단 돌아가서 상황을 지켜봐야겠다. 주점으로 가볼까….): (I should head back and see how things develop. Perhaps I'll try the tavern...)
And here is the very person we were discussing.
Indeed... %s, come over here a moment.
strings.아, 안녕하세요, 레나씨. 아인스트씨. 무슨일이죠?: Oh, hello, Miss Lena, Mr. Einst. What's going on?
Hello. I have a job for you.
Yes. I was supposed to handle it myself, but something has come up.
You may consider this an official request from the empire.
strings.그리고, 이 건에 대해서는 우리 역시 제국에 전면적으로 협조하고 있으니,: And we are cooperating fully with the empire on this matter. Consider it a request from the Guild Union as well.
strings.음……. 대체 어떤 의뢰인가요?: Hmm... What exactly is the job?
strings.얼마전부터 이 근방에서 혼란을 일으키고 있는 우리 제국의 [유격기사단]을: You're familiar with our empire's [Ranger Knights], who have been causing trouble around here lately.
Our investigation identified them as a reconnaissance unit that lost contact with the homeland some time ago.
strings.이들이 제국을 배신했는가, 아니면 어떤 사정이 있는가, 목적이 무엇인가…: Whether they have betrayed the empire, whether there are other circumstances, what their objective is... Discovering that is one of my missions.
Until now, I had no opportunity to investigate. But a chance has presented itself.
strings.엘 아노르 평원을 둘러싸고 있는 산악지대의 산기슭에 이 정찰부대의 기함이: The unit's flagship has crashed at the foot of the mountains surrounding El Anor Plains.
strings.원인은 아직 모르겠어. …길드연합의 영토를 함부로 날아다닌 대가를 받은게: We don't yet know why. ...I can't help wondering whether it was the price of flying freely over Guild Union territory, but that's only speculation.
strings.…길드연합이 제국의 배를 공격했다고 생각하신다면, 오해라고 밖에 드릴 말: ...If you think the Guild Union attacked an imperial ship, all I can say is that you are mistaken.
strings.흠, 상황에 따른 유연한 결단력이 길드연합의 강점이라고 생각합니다만… 물: Hmm. I consider the Guild Union's ability to make flexible decisions as circumstances demand one of its strengths... Of course, I wasn't making an accusation. I hope you won't take offense, Lord Einst.
strings.(……왠지 너구리와 여우의 대화같은 기분이….): (...This feels like listening to a fox and a raccoon dog trying to outwit each other...)
strings.뭐, 아무튼 이건 절호의 기회야. 비공정 추락지대에 가서 [푸른 범고래호: In any case, it's an excellent opportunity. Go to the airship crash site, find the commander of the [Blue Orca], and take him alive. And be sure to report anything you discover.
Yes, sir. Preparations are complete. It's here...
...Good. You must... carry out the mission...
Yes, sir. I will now begin transporting the excavated object.
strings.……인고의 시간을 지나……. 지금 파멸의 문을 열어…. 모든 것이…. 주: ...After an age of endurance... open the gates of ruin... Let everything... burn in the master's wrath...
strings.저기 신분이 높아보이는 기사가 있어. 저 사람이 제국군의 지휘관인가?: There's a knight over there who looks important. Is he the imperial commander?
strings.!! 이런, 적이 여기까지 오다니…. 제가 시간을 벌겠습니다. 자리를 피: !! Damn, the enemy has come this far... I'll buy you time. Get to safety.
...Find an opening and escape... Carry out your mission...
strings.온다, 모두 조심해!: Here he comes! Everyone, be careful!
Whew. I think it's over. That soldier from earlier... got away. Damn...
...He was carrying something too, some object with ominous magic.
Oh, he's coming around. Hmm. Should we tie him up so he doesn't attack again...?
strings.으으, 대체 이건 무슨…. 자네들은 누군가?: Ugh, what in the world...? Who are you?
strings.(이 사람, 분위기가 바뀌었어. 사악한 기운이 사라졌다.): (He's changed. That evil presence is gone.)
strings.으음, 침입자인가! 이 함이 실바리아 제국의 여왕님께서 축복하신 [푸른: Hmm! Intruders! Do you know this is the [Blue Orca], blessed by Her Majesty the Queen of the Silvarian Empire?!
strings.이 맥시밀리앙 하돈파르 블라미디어스 하로나크 돈데크만 다스베이더스 비요~: I, Maximilian Hadonpar Blamidius Haronak Dondekman Darthvaders Bjo~r the Third, swear on my honor as a knight to punish you without mercy!
It has been some time, Sir Bjor.
The young lady of House Hyren! What brings you to such a place?
Sir Bjor, these are my friends and allies of the empire. They are not our enemies.
strings.그리고 내가 이 곳에 있는 것은 여왕 폐하의 뜻을 따르기 위하여… 귀공을: And I am here to carry out Her Majesty's will... To find you.
strings.그렇소. 그대가 어째서 군율을 어기고 제국의 깃발에 등을 돌렸는지, 그리: Indeed. Her Majesty wishes to know why you violated military law and turned your back on the imperial banner. And what result you hoped to achieve.
strings.이 맥시밀리앙 하돈파르 블라미디어스 하로나크 돈데크만 다스베이더스 비요~: I, Maximilian Hadonpar Blamidius Haronak Dondekman Darthvaders Bjo~r the Third, have never for an instant forgotten my duty as an imperial knight!
strings.(………잘 보니 뭔가 믿기 힘든 단어가 이름 중에….): (...Now that I pay attention, there's an unbelievable word hidden in that name...)
strings.어, 어째서 여왕께서 제게 그런 의심을…. 저는 도무지 알 수가 없습니다: W-why would Her Majesty suspect me of such a thing...? I cannot understand it.
...I see. If the [Beholder] says so, it must be true.
Now, Sir Bjor. Then let me ask you this.
strings.어째서 본국과의 연락을 끊었습니까? 모습을 숨긴 동안에 무엇을 한 겁니까: Why did you cut off contact with the homeland? What were you doing while you were hidden from us? Why did you enter El Anor Plains, in Guild Union territory? What relic did you excavate here?
strings.나, 나는 무슨 말씀을 하시는건지 이해가 안되오이다. 나는 정규임무를 수: I-I don't understand what you're saying. I was carrying out my regular duties, leading my unit along our usual patrol route...
strings.그래… 그리고 갑자기 나타난… 거대한 [게이트]에 들어가서…: Yes... And then we entered... an enormous [Gate] that appeared without warning...
...On that beautiful plain... covered in flowers... I met someone...
There... he said... U-urgh... My head...
Enough. Do not try to remember any more.
Lord Einst, we still need to hear the rest.
strings.강력하고 사악한 마력의 잔재가, 아직 그를 속박하고 있소. 지금 그를 다: The remnants of a powerful, malevolent magic still bind him. Pressing him now would be dangerous.
strings.일단 마을로 돌아가, 마법사들과 성기사들의 도움을 받읍시다. 우선은 심신: Let us return to town and seek help from the mages and paladins. His recovery, in body and mind, must come first.
strings.알겠습니다. 비요르경과 그의 부대가 반역자들이 아니라는 것을 알았으니 그: Understood. At least we now know that Sir Bjor and his unit are not traitors.
We are relieved as well. I'd rather not cross swords in earnest with the empire. Haha.
You've been a great help. Thank you.
Oh... Haha, you're welcome. I'm glad I could help.
It seems you and your friends really are the ones the queen foresaw...
strings.네? 지금 뭐라고…?: What? What did you just say...?
strings.('예지'… 라는건 제국의 여왕이 가진 그 '힘' 이야기겠지…. 저들의: (“Foresaw”... She must mean that power the imperial queen possesses... Is there something in their fate worthy of the queen's attention?)
strings.너희들에겐 상황이 어떻게 된건지 이야기를 들을 자격이 있어. 좀 더 상황: You have a right to know what's happening. Once we understand more, I'll be sure to tell you.
I have a feeling we'll be seeing a lot of each other.
Oh, yes. I'll see you again, then.
strings.맥시밀리앙 하돈파르 블라미디어스 하로나크 돈데크만 다스베이더스 비요~르: Maximilian Hadonpar Blamidius Haronak Dondekman Darthvaders Bjo~r the Third... faces his greatest crisis...!
strings.(………흐음, 아까 나와 싸우던 기사대장이 제정신이 아니었다면… 그를 그: (...Hmm. If the knight captain who fought me wasn't in his right mind, someone must have made him that way. Who could it be? What do they want?)
Oh, you... I caused you a great deal of trouble the other day.
Oh, hello, Miss Lena, Mr. Einst, Sir Bjor.
strings.비요르경, 이제 몸은 좀 괜찮으신가요?: Sir Bjor, are you feeling better now?
Oh, yes! I, Bjo~r, am the very picture of physical health.
strings.머릿속은 문제가 좀 있는 것 같습니다만…. (시무룩): My head, however, seems to be having some trouble... (Dejected)
Now, Sir Bjor, there is no need to blame yourself.
Her Majesty will not reproach you either.
strings.하아… 여왕 폐하의 배려를 받다니, 더더욱 송구스럽고, 면목이 없는 일입: Ah... To receive Her Majesty's consideration only makes me feel more apologetic and ashamed...
strings.그러고보니, 무슨 일이 있었는지 좀 알아내셨나요?: Speaking of which, have you found out what happened?
I can't say we've uncovered anything definite.
We do, however, have a plan for what to do next.
Hmm... I have a feeling I'm part of that plan.
strings.날카롭네…. 후훗, 어때, 괜찮겠어?: Perceptive... Hehe. Well? Would you be willing?
A sincere answer. A good one.
All right. Then let's go straight into the briefing.
We'll review what we know so far.
strings.비요르경의 순찰함대가, 허공해에서 우연히 발견한 게이트가 모든 일의 시초: It all began with a Gate that Sir Bjor's patrol fleet discovered by chance in the Void Sea.
It wasn't listed on any navigational chart. Sir Bjor decided to conduct a reconnaissance in force.
Beyond the Gate was a beautiful plain, filled with flowers as far as the eye could see.
It was beautiful, but something about it felt strange.
That is the last clear memory Sir Bjor or the other imperial soldiers have.
Their accounts of what followed are confused and fragmentary.
strings.감히 제국의 깃발을 우습게 여기고 제국의 신민이기도 한 우리 병사들을 우: We must discover who dared dishonor the imperial banner and toy with our soldiers, who are subjects of the empire.
strings.그렇습니다! 이런 악덕한 만행, 필경 세상에 사악한 의도를 가진 악한 마: Indeed! Such vile deeds must be the work of an evil mage with wicked designs on the world! I shall not forgive it!
strings.제국군들을 사로잡았던 마력의 영향을 해소하며 사용된 마법에 대해 조사했습: While lifting the magic that had ensnared the imperial soldiers, I investigated the spell itself.
strings.마법을 이루고 있는 술식의 형태… 그것은 매우 오래된 형태의, 종교적인: The form of its formulas... They were exceedingly ancient and ominous, almost religious in nature.
strings.정확히 어떤 자의 마법인지는 알 수 없었지만,: I could not determine precisely whose magic it was.
strings.한가지 확실한 것은, 그 술사가 제국군 병사들 대부분의 마음을 단숨에 사: But one thing is certain: the caster seized the minds of most of the imperial soldiers in an instant.
strings.수많은 사람들의 마음을 한순간에 손아귀에 넣은 마력… 이것은 그 어떤 대: Magic that takes hold of so many minds at once... Such a feat would be difficult even for the greatest archmage.
strings.인간의 영역을 벗어난… 어떤 강대한 존재가 배후에 있을거란 생각이 드는군: I suspect a powerful being beyond the realm of humanity is behind this.
strings.이 사건의 원흉… 에 대해서는 직접 맞서보아야 알겠지만, 짐작이 가지 않: We won't know who is responsible until we confront them, but I do have my suspicions.
strings.마왕이 패배한 이후에도, 갖가지 혼란이 일어나, 한때 프레이오스는 멸망하: Even after the Demon King's defeat, turmoil continued. There was a time when it seemed Freios itself might be destroyed.
That chaos lasted until the first empire arose.
strings.혼돈의 태반은 인간들 스스로에 의해 자초된 것이었지만, 모든 것이 그랬던: Much of it was brought about by humans themselves. But not all.
For example... The primordial gods of darkness, distinct from the ancient gods we worshiped.
There is the [Demon Realm] they created.
The Demon Realm is... No, that is too long a story. We shall discuss it another time.
strings.아무튼 고대의 제국이 반석에 오르며 대부분 이 세계에서 축출당한 태고의: In any case, those primordial evils were largely driven from this world as the ancient empire established itself.
strings.이 사건의 원인은… 그런 불길하고 오래된 기억에 닿아있는게 아닌가? 그런: The cause of this incident... Might it be connected to those dark and ancient memories? That is the feeling I have.
Good. Then let me give you the assignment.
I'd like you to go to Belpa Library.
It's a library. And also a temple.
strings.네? 도서관이면서 신전…?: What? A library and a temple...?
You'll understand when you see it.
strings.중요한건, 그 곳에 있는 마법의 유물 중에, 제국군이 엘 아노르 평원에서: What matters is that among its magical relics is an object believed to be the counterpart of the one the imperial army excavated in El Anor Plains.
There is a strong chance that the relic in Belpa has already been stolen as well.
strings.…제가 제 정신이 아니었을 때 그런 명령을 한 기억이 어렴풋이 남아있습니: ...I vaguely remember giving that order while I was not myself. The soldier who received it is exceptionally capable and would surely have carried it out... Unfortunately.
strings.유물을 이미 강탈당했건 아니건간에, 벨파에서 추가적인 정보를 얻을 수 있: Whether or not the relic has been stolen, we should be able to learn more at Belpa. It's the best place to start.
strings.그럼 우선 벨파로 출발해줘, 남아있는 증거를 확인하고 필요하다고 생각되는: Head to Belpa first. Examine whatever evidence remains and do what you think is necessary.
strings.길드연합의 의뢰를 받은 모험가가 간다고 해두었으니 벨파의 사서가 도와줄걸: I've told them an adventurer commissioned by the Guild Union is coming. The librarian at Belpa will help you.
Understood. I'll be on my way.
strings.오오, 잘 부탁드립니다!: Oh, thank you! We're counting on you!
2. As long as the pay is good.
strings.후훗, 의외로 이재에 밝군. 일이 잘 풀리면 제국황실에서 보상이 있을거야: Hehe. You have more business sense than I expected. If things go well, the imperial court will reward you.
strings.3. 비요르경을 우롱한 녀석을 혼내줍시다!: 3. Let's teach whoever toyed with Sir Bjor a lesson!
strings.오오, 만난지 얼마 안된 저를 위해서 그렇게까지…?: Oh! You would go that far for me, though we've only just met...?
strings.이 맥시밀리앙 하돈파르 블라미디어스 하로나크 돈데크만 다스베이더스 비요~: I, Maximilian Hadonpar Blamidius Haronak Dondekman Darthvaders Bjo~r the Third, am deeply moved!!!!
strings.오랜만에 풀 네임이 나왔네. 네 덕분에 비요르경이 기운을 차렸는걸. 하하: It's been a while since we heard the full name. You've cheered Sir Bjor right up. Haha.
strings.응? '고고씬'…이 무슨 뜻? 아무튼 빨리 이야기를 진행하지 못해 안달이: Hm? “Go-go-go”...? What does that mean? In any case, you seem impatient to move things along.
strings.아, 안녕하세요. 혹시 이곳의 사서이신가요?: Oh, hello. Are you the librarian here?
strings.(끄덕) 길드연합에서 오신 분들?: (Nods) Are you from the Guild Union?
strings.어, 어…? (팔을 잡히고 끌려간다. 성질이 급한 사람이로군.): H-huh...? (The librarian grabs your arm and pulls you along. What an impatient person.)
Pel, the person we've been waiting for has arrived.
strings.꽥? 마이 프레셔스! 내 책, 내 책이 허공을 난다!?: Squawk! My precious! My book! My book is flying through the air?!
strings.아, 리즈…. 미안해요. 잠시 정신을 놓고 말았네요. 블랑켓 부인의 [가: Oh, Liz... I'm sorry. I lost myself for a moment. Mrs. Blanket's [Garter Belt Assassination] was charging down the third-base line and dealing a fatal blow to the enemy's table manners. It was such a gripping scene...
...Even if it is trashy literature, this book belongs to the library, not you. And losing yourself? At a time like this? Pel, you are forbidden to read until this situation is resolved.
Ohhh... I suppose I have no choice. All right.
strings.그런데 그쪽 분들은?: By the way, who are they?
The adventurers from the Guild Union we've been waiting for.
Oh, I see! Hello! I'm so glad you're here.
strings.이쪽은 저희 벨파 도서관의 수석사서인 펠입니다. 저는 리즈라고 불러주십시: This is Pel, chief librarian of Belpa Library. Please call me Liz.
Um, I don't know whether you've heard, but...
Oh, yes. You wish to see the ancient elven magical relic in our keeping.
strings.(엘프…?) 네 뭐, 그렇습니다. 유물은 안전한가요? 혹시 빼앗겼다던가…: (Elven...?) Yes, that's right. Is the relic safe? It hasn't been stolen, has it...?
In fact, we would like to know that ourselves.
strings.네에 실은, 연락을 받고 유물을 확인하기 위해 관장님께서 [비밀 장서고]: Yes. After receiving word, our director entered the [Secret Archive] to check on the relic. She has not yet returned.
And then monsters suddenly began rampaging through the library.
strings.이 곳 벨파…. 특히 마법 열람실쪽에는 원래 책과 유물에 근원을 둔 생물: Creatures originating from books and relics have always appeared here in Belpa, particularly in the magic reading room. But nothing like this has happened before.
strings.게다가 여러분이 찾는 유물이 있는 [비밀 장서고]… 그 안에서는 무언가: Moreover, a tremendous heat and magical force are raging within the [Secret Archive], where the relic you seek is kept.
strings.불행히도 이번 주는 저희 벨파사서들이 봉사에 임하는 주, 저희 사서들은: Unfortunately, this is our librarians' week of community service. Most of them are away from the library.
strings.남은 소수의 인원이 장서고에 접근하는건 너무 위험하다고 판단, 대기중이었: We judged it too dangerous for our few remaining staff to approach the archive, so we have been standing by.
strings.비밀장서고에는 관장님과, 무언가를 조사하러 오신 엘프 마법사님이 계셨는데: The director and an elven mage who came to investigate something were both in the Secret Archive... I hope they're safe.
Well, the director is no pushover, but she is getting on in years.
strings.알겠습니다. 그럼 서둘러야겠군요. 비밀장서고라고 했죠? 입구가 어디인가요: Understood. Then we'd better hurry. The Secret Archive, you said? Where's the entrance?
strings.이 쪽, [마법 열람실]로 들어가셔서 끝까지 들어가시면 입구를 찾으실 수: Go into the [Magic Reading Room] this way and continue to the very back. You'll find the entrance there.
strings.비밀 장서고라고 해도 입구를 숨겨둔건 아니니까요, 쉽게 찾으실 수 있을거: It may be called the Secret Archive, but the entrance isn't hidden. You should find it easily.
strings.불의 정령, 그것도 아주 강력한 녀석!!!: A fire spirit—and an incredibly powerful one!
strings.…이 느낌은, 폭주중인가? 분노로 보이는게 없나 본데… 이런, 도서관이: ...This feeling... Is it out of control? It seems blinded by rage... Oh no, the library could go up in flames at any moment!
strings.이 비열한 강도들아, 놓치지 않겠다!!!: You vile thieves! You won't escape me!
It seems to have calmed down a little.
strings.이 봐, 기다려, 우린 도둑이 아냐! 벨파 사서들의 부탁을 받고 찾아왔다: Hey, wait! We're not thieves! The Belpa librarians sent us!
strings.…거짓말은 아닌 것 같군…: ...You do not appear to be lying...
strings.(후우, 다행이다. 계속 싸우면 어떻게 될까 싶었는데.): (Whew, thank goodness. I was worried about what would happen if we kept fighting.)
strings.이봐. 우리보다 앞서 이 곳 벨파 도서관의 관장님이 오셨었다고 들었는데,: Listen. We heard the director of Belpa Library came here before us. Where is she?
...D-don't tell me... She was burned to a crisp...?
She was not. She leads the priestesses and possesses great power.
strings.그녀는 도둑을 쫓아 나갔다. 어디로 갔는지는 모른다…: She left in pursuit of the thief. I do not know where she went...
...The thief who stole the Book of Shadows I was guarding.
strings.그렇군…. 당신은 유물을 지키는 수호자 같은 존재구나?: I see... So you're a guardian of the relic?
Yes. Though, to my shame, I failed to uphold my contract...
strings.으음, 억지로 다시 나와서 이야길 하다보니 봉인이 쑤시는군, 뼛속까지 시: Ugh. Forcing myself out again to speak has made the seal ache. The chill goes right through my bones...! I must return to my seal now.
strings.………………뼛 속까지 시리다니, 봉인이란거 류마티스 같은건가?: ...Chilled to the bone? Is being sealed something like having rheumatism?
Hmm. I'd better tell the people waiting in the lobby what we learned.
Oh... A thief in the Secret Archive.
strings.그랬군요…. 유물을 빼앗긴 것은 큰 일이지만, 관장님이 무사하셔서 다행이: I see... Losing the relic is serious, but I'm relieved the director is safe.
strings.그건 그렇고, 책의 수호자로 상급 불의 정령인 이프리트를 붙여놓다니. 뭔: Still, assigning Ifrit, a high-ranking fire spirit, to guard a book... What a thoroughly chaotic idea. Huh...
strings.저희 벨파의 사서들은 지식, 특히 [책]을 수호하는 자, 그렇기에 오히려: We Belpa librarians guard knowledge, and [books] in particular. That is precisely why we know a thing or two about handling fire, Pel.
strings.뭐, 확실히 독특한 발상인건 인정합니다. 펠, 당신 못지 않은 사서가 또: I admit it is an unusual idea, though. It seems there's another librarian to rival even you, Pel.
What? Hehehe, I'm not that special.
strings.(…칭찬이 아닌 것 같은데): (...I don't think that was a compliment.)
In any case, I believe we owe you an apology.
strings.네? 사죄? 혹시, 빼앗긴 유물이 저희가 찾는 그건가요?: What? An apology? Is the stolen relic the one we're looking for?
strings.짐작하시는 대로, 이프리트가 수호하던 책이 여러분이 찾는 유물, [그림자: As you suspect, the book Ifrit guarded is the relic you seek: the [Book of Shadows].
The Book of Shadows... That sounds like a spellbook.
strings.맞습니다. 관련된 문헌에는, 그림자의 책은 어떤 대상을 [현실]에서 [그: Correct. According to the relevant texts, the Book of Shadows has the power to banish something from [reality] into the world of [shadows].
It is also described as a [fragment of destruction created to prevent the world's destruction]. Fighting poison with poison, perhaps?
strings.필경 좋지 않은 의도를 가진 자가 이 책을 탈취한 거라면… 큰 재해가 될: If someone with ill intentions has taken the book... it could bring a great catastrophe.
Hmm... This keeps getting more serious, and heavier. I really don't like it...
strings.아무튼, 벨파에 더 있을 이유가 없는 것 같군요. 저는 유물을 훔친 자를: Anyway, there seems little reason to stay in Belpa. I need to go after whoever stole the relic.
strings.앞으로 어떻게 하실 생각이세요?: What do you intend to do next?
Hmm. I'm going to try the unidentified Gate the imperial army found in the Void Sea.
strings.정체불명의 게이트! 그 앞에 어떤 위험이 펼쳐져 있을지 알 수 없는 것이: An unidentified Gate! Who knows what dangers await beyond it? How exciting...! May luck be with you!
More... enemies? I may not... be able to take any more.
You are... the ones I met on the airship.
strings.맞아요. 그때 비요르경 옆에 있던 병사가 당신이지요?: That's right. You were the soldier beside Sir Bjor, weren't you?
You don't need to be so wary. There was a reason we fought Sir Bjor.
strings.이건 레나 하이렌이란 분이 준 표식인데, 이걸 보면 날 믿어줄거라고 하던: Someone named Lena Hyren gave me this insignia. She said you'd trust me if I showed it to you... Do you?
strings.하이렌… 분명 제국 굴지의 대귀족인 가문의 이름일텐데… 아, 이건…!!!: Hyren... One of the empire's greatest noble houses... Oh, this is...!
This is the emblem of the [Silver Claw], the imperial court's special organization.
strings.…이 문양의 소지자에게 협조하는 것은 제국 군인의 의무… 지요. 알겠습니: ...It is an imperial soldier's duty to cooperate with whoever bears this emblem. Understood. Tell me what you need.
Whew. I'm glad we could clear that up.
strings.그럼 우선, 벨파 도서관에 침입해서 유물을 가져간건 당신이지요?: First, you were the one who entered Belpa Library and took the relic, weren't you?
strings.비요르경의 명령은 자신의 의사가 아니었어요. 정체불명의 마법이 비요르경과: Sir Bjor's orders weren't his own. Apparently, an unknown magic was controlling him and many of the imperial soldiers.
strings.엘 아노르 평원에서 발굴한 유물과, 도서관에서 가져간 유물, 두 개를 돌: The relic excavated in El Anor Plains and the one taken from the library both need to be returned. Please give them to me.
strings.대장님께서 마법에 지배당했…다고?: The captain was... being controlled by magic?
...I see... Yes... That does make sense.
strings.주변 동료들의 이상한 낌새라든가, 생각해보면 수상했던 점이 한 두개가 아: The way my comrades were acting... Looking back, there were so many suspicious things. I was a fool...
I'm sorry. I no longer have the relics.
Now that I look, you're badly hurt...! Does that mean...?
strings.상상하시는 대로일겁니다. 저는 지시에 따라 유물을 전달할 상대가 기다리고: It is probably as you imagine. Following my orders, I entered the [Flower Garden], where the recipient should have been waiting for the relics.
strings.(화원… 저기에 보이는 것이 화원의 입구인가?): (The Flower Garden... Is that its entrance over there?)
But the person I was to meet was nowhere to be seen. Instead, countless monsters appeared...
I barely escaped, but lost the relics on the way out.
Hmm. Then the relics should still be in that garden.
There is a chance they aren't, but it needs to be checked.
strings.혹시 유물을 가져오길 요구한게 누구인지는 모르시나요?: Do you know who requested the relics?
strings.제가 받은 명령은 유물을 이 곳에 가져오라는 것 뿐… 그 외에는 아무 것: My only orders were to bring them here. I know nothing beyond that.
You seem to be adventurers of extraordinary ability.
strings.부탁드립니다. 저 화원에서 유물들을 되찾아주시지 않겠습니까?: Please. Would you recover the relics from that garden?
strings.만약 그 유물들이 제국에 반하는 자들의 손에 들어가 악용당한다면, 큰일입: If they fall into the hands of the empire's enemies and are misused, the consequences could be terrible...!
I was planning to do that even without being asked. Stay here and recover your strength.
Thank you. I'm ashamed to trouble you...
Well, all you did wrong was faithfully follow orders. Don't blame yourself too much.
Well, unfamiliar faces. A pleasure to meet you.
strings.모험가… 들이시군? 이런 좋은 계절에 발길닿는대로 정처없는 여행길…. 좋: Adventurers, are you...? Wandering wherever your feet take you in such a fine season... How lovely. It makes me wish I could set off somewhere too.
Ah, I've forgotten to introduce myself.
My name is Degos. I am the master of this place. A pleasure.
strings.내 입으로 말하긴 부끄럽지만, 아름다운 화원이지요? 이 곳은 제 자랑거리: I'm embarrassed to say it myself, but isn't it a beautiful garden? It's my pride and joy.
Yes, it's wonderful. Splendid, yet somehow unassuming.
strings.이 앞의 평원도 참 평화롭고 행복해보이고… 이 부근은 정말 아름다운 곳이: The plain outside looks so peaceful and happy too... This whole area is beautiful.
strings.(하지만 왠지 인기척이 느껴지지 않는 것 같기도… 한적한 시골이라 그런가: (Though I can't seem to sense anyone around... Perhaps because it's such a quiet countryside.)
Thank you. My subjects are kind and hardworking, so this is a pleasant land to live in.
As an incompetent lord, I can only feel grateful and apologetic toward them.
Oh... You're the lord of this land.
strings.(마침 잘 됐네. 이 분에게 이 땅에 대해 물어보면 되겠어.): (Perfect. I can ask him about this place.)
strings.저, 실례지만 여쭤볼 것이…: Excuse me, but there's something I'd like to ask...
strings.으음, 몬스터 녀석, 또 날뛸 셈인가… 지금 날뛰면 막을 도리가 없는데,: Hmm. That monster means to rampage again... I have no way to stop it now. This is serious...!
Oh dear, in my distraction I forgot to warn you. My apologies.
This garden is extremely dangerous at present. Monsters are appearing everywhere.
strings.네? 몬스터요? (유격병 아저씨가 이야기한 몬스터들을 말하는걸까?): What? Monsters? (The ones that ranger told me about?)
strings.그렇소. 부하들과 화원 근처의 평원에서 사냥을 하던 도중에, 갑자기 거대: Yes. While my men and I were hunting on the plain near the garden, an enormous beast suddenly appeared.
strings.어떻게 이 화원 안으로 몰아넣긴 했지만, 마물의 수하로 보이는 작은 몬스: We managed to drive it into this garden, but then many smaller monsters appeared, seemingly its servants...
strings.가까스로 일단 물리치긴 했지만, 부하들은 많이 다쳤어요. 지금은 응원군을: We barely drove them back, and my men were badly hurt. I've sent them to call for reinforcements.
strings.솔직히, 좀 버거운 느낌이 들지만… 녀석이 화원을 탈출해서 영민들을 괴롭: Frankly, it feels like more than I can handle... But it would be a disaster if the creature escaped the garden and attacked my subjects, wouldn't it? As their lord, I must do something. Hahaha.
strings.여러분도, 화원이 평화로워졌을때 방문해주시면 환영하겠소이다. 지금은 몸을: You're welcome to visit once peace returns to the garden. For now, you should take shelter.
If that's the situation, I'd like to help.
Yes. Please leave the monsters to me.
strings.타인을 위해 위험을 무릅쓰다니 비할 바 없는 고결한 마음가짐…!: To risk danger for others... Such incomparable nobility of spirit...!
strings.아니, 겸손할 필요 없습니다. 누구나 당신처럼 타인을 위해 자신의 위험을: No need for modesty. Not everyone would put themselves in danger for someone else, as you would.
strings.사실, 나와 내 부하들이 문제를 해결해야 마땅하지만, 우리 병사들이나 나: Truthfully, my men and I should be the ones to solve this. But neither they nor I are particularly accustomed to fighting.
strings.이 땅에 분쟁이 있던게 워낙 오래 전이 되어놔서… 제대로 싸울 수 있을지: It's been so long since this land last saw conflict... I'm not even sure we can fight properly anymore. How embarrassing.
strings.당신들이 강력한 모험가라는건 사실 첫눈에알아봤어요. 분명 당신들이라면 괜: In fact, I could tell at first glance that you were powerful adventurers. I'm sure you could handle it.
I am ashamed as a lord... But I must put my pride aside and ask for your help.
strings.화원의 몬스터들을 일소하고, 그 두목으로 보이는 머리가 셋 달린 괴물개를: Please clear the monsters from the garden, then defeat the three-headed monstrous dog that appears to lead them.
strings.영민들의 안전을 위해서이니, 이 일을 해결해주신다면 최대한 성의를 표시하: It is for my subjects' safety. If you resolve this, I will show my gratitude as generously as I can.
strings.음. 좋은 소식 기다리겠소. 무운을 빕니다!: Good. I look forward to hearing good news. May victory be yours!
strings.네. 그럼, 여기서 기다리세요. 조심하시길!: All right. Wait here, then. Stay safe!
strings.(…그런데, 아까부터 무언가 놓치고 있다는 생각이 드는데… 뭐지?): (...But I've felt for a while as though I'm forgetting something... What is it?)
strings.(잘 모르겠네. 날씨가 너무 좋아서 그런지… 머리가 잘 안 돌아가는 것: (I don't know. Perhaps it's the lovely weather... My thoughts seem sluggish...)
strings.(그리고 이 꽃 향기… 화원의 향기가, 너무 짙… 은… 건 아닌지?): (And this floral scent... Isn't the garden's fragrance... a little... too strong?)
...Hmm. Am I overheated? I need to pull myself together.
Ah, that's the cry I heard at the entrance...
strings.미안하지만! 얌전히 있어줘야겠어!: Sorry, but I'll have to make you behave!
Whew. That was a hard fight.
It's a shame, but I can't let you keep rampaging...
Is this Cerberus... your pet, by any chance...?
strings.자아, 지금 해방시켜줄게…!: All right, I'll free you now...!
strings.(케르베로스가 여성으로 변했다! 저 기다란 귀는… 미드가르드에서 본 엘프: (Cerberus has turned into a woman! Those long ears... An elf, like the ones in Midgard?)
Oh dear, she isn't coming around. The shock must have been severe. What should I do...?
Dessert... I can't eat any more. Nom, nom...
strings.나, 날개달린 멍멍이가 된 꿈을 꾸었어요. 상쾌하게 바람을 가르며 예쁜: I-I dreamed I was a winged dog. I ran and played among beautiful flowers, with the breeze rushing past me.
strings.(디저트 먹는 꿈 아니었나? …그 디저트가 나였다던가!!…….): (Wasn't she dreaming about dessert? ...Was I the dessert?!...)
Honestly... That's just like you, Soleil.
strings.플라티나씨, 소레이유씨라면 혹시…: Miss Platina, if she's Soleil, could she be...?
strings.벨파 도서관에서 실종되었다는 엘프 마법사 소레이유씨가 아닌지…?: The elven mage Soleil who went missing from Belpa Library...?
What...? Missing? Oh my... How terrible.
strings.당신 이야기이옵니다만…. 그만 잠에서 깨어나시죠 아가씨!: We're talking about you, my dear. Do wake up already!
But don't be too pleased with yourselves.
strings.완전하진 않으나마, 이 땅의 봉인은 깨어졌다… 마계와 이 세계를 가로막던: Though not completely, the seal on this land has been broken... The barrier between the Demon Realm and this world is gone.
strings.…나는 돌아올 것이다. 돌아와서, 반드시 네놈들을! 차라리 죽여달라고!: ...I will return. And when I do, I will make you beg—beg me to kill you instead!!!!
strings.하하하하하하하…. 재회의 날, 즐거이 기다리게나…: Hahahahahahaha... Look forward to the day we meet again...
strings.…제길, 언제라도 상대해줄테니 지금은 꺼져버려…!: ...Damn you. I'll fight you anytime, so get out of here for now...!
Did he return to the Demon Realm? Or was he sealed away? Whew. Either way... he's gone.
For now... I'd better rejoin Miss Platina and the others.
Thanks to you, we defeated the one who bewitched the imperial army and stole the magical relics.
strings.하지만, 마계에 침식되어있던 이 땅을 세계와 분리하고 있던 마법은 사라졌: But the magic separating this land, which the Demon Realm had encroached upon, from the world is gone.
This region has now returned to this world... to Freios.
strings.그와 함께, 이 지역을 침식하고 있던 마계 역시 이 세계와 연결되고 말았: And with it, the Demon Realm that had invaded this land has become connected to our world.
...Ah, the road ahead will be difficult.
First, we need to deal with what's in front of us.
We have to stabilize this garden so the darkness covering it doesn't spill outside.
Well, then... You've worked very hard.
Oh... But it feels like I haven't helped...
I'm truly sorry... This is all because of me...
strings.자자, 무슨 말씀! 데고스를 물리쳐준 덕분에 사태가 최악이 되지는 않았어: Now, now! What are you saying? Defeating Degos prevented the worst outcome.
strings.맞아요. 데몬 로드가 지역 전체를 마계와 통하는 [문]으로 만들어 활짝: Exactly. If that Demon Lord had turned the whole region into a [doorway] to the Demon Realm and thrown it wide open, the result would have been horrifying.
strings.그 전에 데고스를 물리쳐주셔서, 물을 채운 제방에 구멍이 생긴 정도… 로: You defeated Degos before that happened. So we've contained it to something more like... a hole in a dam full of water.
That's right. Don't be disappointed in yourself over every little thing beyond your reach.
strings.거기 군인 아저씨도 마찬가지. 뭐 잘한건 없지만 잘못했달 것 까지야 없잖: That goes for you too, Mr. Soldier. You didn't do well, but it's not as though you did anything truly wrong either.
Hmm. You're right. We should do what we can.
strings.어차피 [마왕] 앞에서 풍전등화인 이 세상, 위험이 하나 더해진것 뿐이죠: This world's already a candle in the wind before the [Demon King]. It's only one more danger, right? Ugh.
strings.자꾸 거치적거리면 다 날려버릴거야 이녀석들아~: Keep getting in my way, and I'll blow you all away, you pests!
strings.그래그래! 그 기세야! 아하하. 마왕과도 대적하는 모험가들이 이정도 일로: Yes, yes! That's the spirit! Ahaha. Adventurers who face even the Demon King can't let something like this frighten them!
strings.[마왕]…. 플라티나에게 사정을 듣기는 했지만, 아아, 동화에서나 듣던: The [Demon King]... Platina told me the situation, but to think a name I'd only heard in fairy tales is real... I suddenly feel faint...
strings.그럼, 저는 길드연합의 분들과 제국에서 온 레나씨에게 일의 전말을 알려드: Then I should tell the Guild Union and Miss Lena from the empire what happened. Will you two be all right? What about the soldier?
strings.응, 덕분에 이 곳도 그리 위험하진 않아졌으니까. 걱정말고 가보세요! 이: Yes. Thanks to you, it isn't so dangerous here anymore. Don't worry—go on! We'll look after him and send him back.
strings.비록 [그림자의 서]와 [파괴의 지팡이]는 파괴되었지만, 완전히 악용되지: Though the [Book of Shadows] and [Staff of Destruction] were destroyed, at least they weren't fully exploited. Thank you for your help.
Thank you so much. Please let me repay this kindness someday.
Oh... There's no need. Really... Well, I'll see you next time. Take care.
strings.봉인된 대지의 주인 데고스…. 2시대에 프레이오스를 공포에 떨게 했던 대: Degos, master of the sealed land... One of the great demons that terrorized Freios during the Second Age.
A path connecting the Demon Realm to this world... This has become something tremendous.
strings.('절망의 폭풍이 하늘을 검게 몰아치고, 세찬 바람속에 깃털처럼 희망은: (“A storm of despair will blacken the sky, and amid the raging wind, hope will come silently, like a feather.” ...That is what Her Majesty said.)
strings.(이 사건도, 이들이 운명의 모험가라는 전조에 불과한걸까?): (Is even this incident only an omen that these are the adventurers of destiny?)
I think you need to meet the queen and speak with her as soon as possible.
strings.여왕…. 제국을 다스리는 분 말씀이시군요?: The queen... You mean the ruler of the empire?
strings.사실 내가 이곳에 온 것은, 여왕님의 명령에 따라, 당신들이 이 땅에 오: In fact, I came here on the queen's orders: to welcome you when you reached this land and bring you to her.
strings.에? 제가 여기에 오는 것을 그분이 알고 계셨다고요?: What? She knew I would come here?
Yes. You'll understand when you meet her. She's a mysterious person.
I'll tell you as soon as the preparations are ready. Thank you for everything you've done.
Since the moment you arrived in this town, you've accomplished one remarkable thing after another. I'm impressed.
Oh, well... Anyone would have done the same in those circumstances...
strings.(마법사로서 한 번 이 분 같은 뛰어난 모험가들과 함께 여행하며 세상을: (As a mage, I've hoped for a chance to travel with adventurers as gifted as these and explore the world. Heh... Somehow, I feel that chance may come.)
strings.(이런 거대한 사건에 직면했어도 차분한 태도…\n마치 이런 일 보다 훨씬:
(So composed, even after confronting an event of this magnitude...
As though they have something far more important than this to overcome.)
strings.(왜일까, 저 모험가들을 보고 있자면…. 우리 [폭풍의 감시자]의 운명에: (Why is it that when I look at these adventurers... I feel some great turning point approaching in the fate of us [Storm Watchers]?)
strings.(이것은 단순한 착각일까, 아니면 [주시자]로서의 선견…?): (Is it merely my imagination, or foresight as a [Watcher]...?)
Heh... I suppose time will tell...
Ahhh! If this sort of thing keeps happening, there won't be a muscle left in me that doesn't ache.
For now, I need a good rest. ...Still, it was worthwhile. Haha...
